Thanks for looping us in. A couple of operational guardrails I've used for similar transitions:

1) Keep a single "manager-only" doc per employee with dated entries (no attachments) so it's easy to export if Legal asks. I have a template attached you can copy into the HR vault.
2) During the first 30 days, do weekly 1:1s and a weekly sync with the outgoing manager — Chase those quick wins first.
3) For the check-in, avoid new performance framing language in the public performance doc unless we've had a calibration meeting.

Laura — I'll join Tue 10th at 10am PT and I can help run calibration if helpful.
